attacks.claim: Dark mode is broken for day cards. `.day-card` hardcodes `background: #ffffff` instead of `var(--surface)`, while dark mode sets `--text` to near-white. Titles and day names become nearly invisible on white cards, and `--muted` (#a1a1a6) on white falls far below WCAG AA contrast. About 30% of users run dark mode.
attacks.evidence: .day-card { background: #ffffff; color: var(--text); ... } with dark block --text: #f2f2f7; --muted: #a1a1a6

attacks.claim: QA covers only light mode, on Chrome 1440px and iPhone 14 (390px). Dark mode and the 360px low end of the mobile range (68% of sessions) were never tested, so the dark-mode defect went undetected. Lighthouse results do not specify the mode.
attacks.evidence: Visual QA vs Figma: Chrome 1440px (light), Safari iPhone 14 (light) — pass

attacks.claim: The mobile action bar is `position: fixed` at 72px height, but `.planner` has only 16px padding and nothing reserves bottom space. The Sunday card and its Swap/overflow buttons can be hidden behind the bar at the end of scroll. There is also no safe-area inset handling for iPhone home indicators.
attacks.evidence: .action-bar { position: fixed; ... bottom: 0; height: 72px; ... } and "Sunday is the last child of .planner"; .planner padding: 16px

attacks.claim: Removing the tile-level "+ List" button turns the most frequent planner action (9.4 times/week per weekly-active user, 64% on mobile) into a roughly five-step flow. No shortcut replaces it, and no usability or funnel evidence supports the tradeoff. The change ships to 100% of users at once.
attacks.evidence: The old tile-level "+ List" button is removed to declutter tiles. ... tap the tile → recipe page → "Ingredients" tab → choose servings in the servings sheet → "Add to list"

attacks.claim: Every tile's Swap button has the same accessible name, "Swap", so screen-reader users cannot tell which recipe it affects. Only the overflow button names its recipe. The 100 Lighthouse accessibility score does not catch this.
attacks.evidence: <button class="btn-ghost">Swap</button> vs <button class="btn-icon" aria-label="More options for Sheet-pan gnocchi">

attacks.claim: The rollout goes straight to 100% with no staged ramp, and the watch metrics have no thresholds or rollback trigger. The flag does make rollback possible.
attacks.evidence: Ship to 100% Tue 10:00 PT behind `planner_v7`... Watch: planner page JS errors, shopping-list additions/WAU, planner bounce rate.

attacks.claim: "Generate shopping list" adds the whole week with no confirmation. The Undo is specified only for the per-recipe flow, and the artifact does not say whether the bulk add merges with or duplicates existing list items.
attacks.evidence: "Generate shopping list" (adds all planned recipes for the week)

attacks.claim: Touch drag between days on mobile is not in the QA list, and there is no stated handling of conflict with scrolling. Only keyboard and VoiceOver were tested.
attacks.evidence: Drag-and-drop between days, "Move to…" menu with keyboard (Tab/Enter/Arrow) and VoiceOver: pass.
